title: Customer data governance funnel and response protocol
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers frequently submit non-bug requests related to logging/PII retention, log redaction, and audit exports. Current handling is ad hoc across support, sales, and engineering and leads to inconsistent SLAs and missed compliance expectations.

Goal: Deliver a repeatable, documented intake funnel + triage protocol that routes requests to the correct owner, assigns an initial risk/effort score, provides templated customer responses, and defines clear SLAs for each outcome (policy change, engineering work, guidance, or escalation to legal/security). The funnel should work for hosted, dedicated, and private customers and integrate with Support and Console workflows.

Out of scope for initial delivery: engineering changes to runtime logging pipeline (will be tracked separately as ENG work), long-term audit-export tooling (phase 2).
comments: 2025-01-10 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after recurring case review with Support and Sales. Captured initial list of common request types (PII redaction, retention extension/reduction, audit export format, scheduling of export job).

2025-01-13 - Liam O'Connor: Met with Legal and Security. Legal requires classification layer that flags requests with potential regulation impact (GDPR/CCPA) and an explicit escalation path. Security requested a mandatory checklist for Private deployments. Added security_review_required flag.

2025-01-15 - Product: Drafted triage funnel: 1) Intake form (Support + Console) 2) Auto-classifier (PII vs metadata vs export vs retention) 3) Risk & effort scoring 4) Route to owner (Docs/Guidance, Controls PM, ENG runtime queue, Legal/Security) 5) Customer response templates + SLA. Seeking engineering estimates for automation effort.

2025-01-16 - Design: Initial UX wireframes for intake form posted (link below). Proposed minimal fields: customer tier, environment (hosted/dedicated/private), sample logs, requested action, regulatory impact checkbox, desired SLA. UX asks for anonymized sample.

2025-01-18 - Engineering (Liam): Scoped automation effort: classifier prototype (ENG-2461) 3w, intake API + Console UI 2w, support tooling + macros 1w. Total ~6w cross-team. Identified dependency on ENG-2345 (log-consumer schema stabilization).

2025-01-20 - PM: Prioritized MVP for high-risk/high-impact enterprise requests (SLA 72h) and a self-serve guidance path for low-risk requests (SLA 10 business days). Decided to ship intake form and manual triage first, then add auto-classifier in phase 2.

2025-01-21 - Legal: Approved escalation criteria; formal review required for requests that change retention to >2 years or that request deletion exemptions. Added requirement to track all decisions in ticketing system for audits.
2025-01-22 - PM: Finalized acceptance criteria and owner matrix, assigned ENG-2461 and ENG-2345 as dependencies. Preparing PRD and rollout plan for stakeholder review.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form available to Support agents and surfaced in Console for enterprise org admins
Support workflows include templated responses for the 5 most common request archetypes
A documented triage matrix exists that maps request type + customer tier -> owner + SLA
All requests record regulatory-impact flag and sample log artifact or sanitized sample
Escalation path to Legal/Security is documented with contact rotation and expected SLA
Manual triage process validated in shadow for 2 weeks with at least 10 customer cases
Metrics dashboard tracks time-to-first-response, time-to-resolution, and escalations for governance requests
decision_points: Phase 1: Manual intake + routing (ship in 3 weeks) vs Phase 2: add auto-classifier (goal for Q2)
SLA tiers: 72h for high-risk enterprise requests, 10 business days for guidance, 5 days for low-effort runtime changes
Data access for triage: require anonymized sample logs by default; enforce special-handling agreement for full-log access
Support vs Engineering ownership: guidance/docs and policy changes owned by Controls PM, runtime changes owned by ENG runtime team
implementation_tasks: Design intake UI and support macros (DES-431)
Build intake API and ticketing integration (ENG-2461)
Author customer response templates and enable macros in Support UI
Create legal/security escalation playbook and contact rotation
Instrument governance request metrics in Console
notes_for_engineering: ENG dependency: log-consumer schema stabilization (ENG-2345) must land before we accept sample payloads in the intake API
If customers are private/vpc: ensure intake flow includes channel for secure artifact upload (S3 presigned or encrypted transfer).
Retention changes that require runtime work should include compatibility checklist (model compatibility, KV cache implications, quantization impact on logs).
